inlines.v: SOMETIMES, adverb [some and times.] 1. At times; at intervals; not always; not and then. We are sometimes indisposed, sometimes occupied, sometimes at leisure; that is, at some times. It is good that we be sometimes contradicted. 2. At one time; opposed to another time.
